facts.label: Quote options
facts.text: Nationwide offers an auto quote and agent directory through its product page. Confirm availability and policy terms for your location.

facts.label: Mileage-based pricing
facts.text: SmartMiles combines a base premium with a variable premium based on the days and miles driven and the coverages in force. Availability varies.

facts.label: Bundling
facts.text: Nationwide advertises home and auto bundling. Its published savings example is based on a national sample, not a guaranteed discount or a quote for every driver.
